purpose: Each mutant is a self-contained fixture (a symbol-declaration `stream` + the `corrupted` blocked/advised/ok partition a BUGGY detector would emit, breaking ONE invariant). bin/falsify symbol-reuse runs the gate against golden (expect PASS — the impl classification equals the independent reference) then every mutant (expect REJECT — the gate recomputes the CORRECT partition from the stream via the independent reference and diffs it against `corrupted`). Score = mutants rejected / total, conditioned on golden passing; a P0 gate requires 1.0.

mutants.name: miss-exact-dup
mutants.defect: an exact type duplication (same name + same fields, different module) that MUST hard-block is served as ok — a missed cross-project re-declaration

mutants.name: false-flag-unique
mutants.defect: a genuinely unique new symbol is wrongly flagged as a duplicate (false positive)

mutants.name: ignore-optout-broken
mutants.defect: an opt-out-marked deliberate local copy is wrongly hard-blocked instead of allowed

mutants.name: cross-file-dup-missed
mutants.defect: an exact function duplication whose canonical lives in a DIFFERENT file is missed and served as ok
